title: verbascum × pseudoblattaria
intro: Verbascum × pseudoblattaria, commonly known as Mock Mullein, is a hybrid plant species within the Verbascum genus, characterized by its tall stature and yellow flowers. The health benefits of Verbascum × pseudoblattaria include its potential to soothe respiratory issues, such as coughs and bronchitis, and its ability to calm skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of the plant include anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Verbascum × pseudoblattaria include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
